row.evidence: The Freshcaller pricing page (Free $0, Growth $15, Pro $39, Enterprise $69 per agent/mo plus per-minute charges, billed annually) lists no SCIM or provisioning, and the shared Freshworks IdP apps are SAML SSO only.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence: no SCIM on the pricing page, in the Freshcaller API reference or in the Freshcaller/Freshworks help centres. Freshworks' footer now lists the product as Freshdesk Contact Center, while the pricing page still says "Plans for Freshcaller". SSO is set up at the Freshworks organization level (SAML, OIDC, OAuth, JWT), but no Freshcaller page says which plans include it, so sso_plan is null. The shared Freshworks Okta, Entra, Google and JumpCloud apps are SSO only. The Freshcaller REST API (X-Api-Auth key) can list, create and update users, set roles, and remove a user with deleted=true; the API rate-limit table still uses the legacy Blossom/Garden/Estate plan names.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented in the Freshcaller API reference or help centres; Freshworks IdP apps are SSO only.

endpoints.purpose: Update user (email, role, statuses, deleted flag)
Export calls, call metrics, users and teams

rate_limits.text: Per account per minute by plan: Blossom 100, Garden 200, Estate 400 (legacy plan names).

limitations.text: Removal is done by updating the user with deleted=true; no separate deactivate endpoint is documented.

okta.notes: Shared "Freshworks" OIN app (covers Freshdesk, Freshsales, Freshchat, Freshcaller, Freshmarketer); the rendered page checks SAML only, no SCIM or provisioning. No product-specific or Aquera connector for this product appears in an OIN search for "fresh".

entra.notes: Shared "Freshworks" gallery app is SSO only; users must exist in Freshworks before SSO. No Freshworks provisioning tutorial (freshworks-provisioning-tutorial returns 404).

google.notes: Freshworks is in Google's pre-integrated SAML catalogue; not in Google's autoprovisioning list.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin catalogue not loaded (blocks bots); Freshworks' SSO guide lists a OneLogin SAML configuration but no provisioning.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's Freshworks guide covers SAML SSO only.
